commits.author: karansag
commits.message:
[eval] Preserve echo payloads when generation overrides are set (#10534)

Preserve lm-eval's echo/loglikelihood payload when caller generation
overrides are configured. A `max_gen_toks=256` override previously
expanded the echoed response with generated tokens that lm-eval included
in its loglikelihood sum. The completions path now keeps the original
`max_tokens=1`, `temperature=0`, and `seed=1234`, subject only to the
existing downward context cap.

The failing BoolQ run used the generic
`experiments/evaluation/configs/evalchemy/boolq.yaml` (`max_tokens:
256`). The campaign configuration at
`experiments/evaluation/campaigns/eval-campaign-09-25-unlabeled/evalchemy-configs/boolq.yaml`
has no cap, so H100 runs using it, including the 0.832 BoolQ accuracy
baseline, are unaffected. Together with merged #10526, this fixes both
sides: the client suppresses generation overrides for loglikelihood
tasks, and vendored Evalchemy ignores them on echo requests. See the
[parity
results](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/10270#issuecomment-6326371478).

The local-chat and OpenAI-chat adapters reject loglikelihood requests;
their payload helpers default to `generate=False` even for chat
generation. They retain generation overrides, covered by a regression
test. The change is limited to the vendored payload guard and tests.

The vendored completion tests passed (33), the Evalchemy config tests
passed (58), and the generation config and override contract tests
passed (97). Repository formatting and type checks passed. The commands
were `host-test-budget uv run --directory vendor/evalchemy --frozen
--group test pytest tests/test_completion_responses.py -q`,
`host-test-budget /home/karan/oa/marin-task-258/.venv/bin/python -m
pytest tests/evals/test_evalchemy_config.py -q`, `host-test-budget uv
run --directory vendor/evalchemy --frozen --group test pytest
tests/contracts/test_generation_config.py
tests/contracts/test_generation_overrides.py -q`, and
`./infra/pre-commit.py --changed-files --fix`, respectively.

Part of #10270.

commits.message:
[levanter] Resume interrupted Hugging Face model mirrors (#10276)

Resume incomplete Hugging Face model mirrors by comparing stored file
sizes
with the requested repository tree. Keep files of the expected size;
download
missing or partial files, and check upload size before writing the
completion
marker. Retries no longer read the contents of completed regional
shards.

A same-size corrupt object will be reused because retries do not hash
stored
files. Regional retry throughput has not been measured for GLM-5.2.

All 16 model-cache tests pass. The affected safe suite had 507 passes
and four
skips.

Fixes #9230
